summary: Ryanair Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly share buybacks under its existing program announced 20 May 2025. From 17–21 August 2026, it repurchased 205,824 ordinary shares at an average of €23.42 and 86,810 ADS-underlying shares at an average of US$27.85, all for cancellation. Prices ranged from €22.61–€24.27 and US$27.27–US$28.97. The buyback is a routine issuer tender under EU Market Abuse Regulation Article 5(1)(b). No board recommendation or advisor is involved. Watch for continued weekly cancellations reducing share count, a modest pro-EPSS tailwind.
